set.statement: rhiza request <text> [--kind feature|bug|milestone] queues a plan request in the clone's .git/rhiza/requests.json, rhiza request ls shows each request's state, and the daemon, when not paused and a slot is free, starts a plan run for the oldest queued feature or bug request, autonomous when rhiza.autonomy.plan is auto, marking the request with its run and later the change set it planned; a queued milestone request instead starts at the next poll, first and without a free slot (milestone-request-starts-at-once)

set.acceptance: daemon-request-slot.txtar with a fake rex: with max-runs 2, two ready change sets and no request, daemon --once starts both ship runs; with one queued request and max-runs 1 it starts one ship run and the request stays queued; with max-runs 2 it starts one ship run and the request's plan run, and daemon status shows the other change set as no-slot with 'waiting for a slot: kept for queued continuations or a plan request'; with max-runs 2, two ready change sets and only a queued milestone request, daemon --once starts both ship runs and the milestone request's plan run, and daemon status shows no no-slot change set; go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/daemon-request-slot passes
set.statement: While a queued feature or bug plan request could start (no run, its retry time passed) and max-runs is above 1, the daemon's ship picks leave one slot for the request's plan run (besides any kept for queued continuations); a ready change set held back by this shows in daemon status as no-slot with the detail 'waiting for a slot: kept for queued continuations or a plan request'. A queued milestone request keeps no slot, since it starts without one. With max-runs 1, or no feature or bug request waiting, picks are unchanged

At each poll the daemon holds everything it would launch (picks, resumes of interrupted runs, queued starts and continues, feature and bug plan requests) while a window's use so far plus the mean tokens of the last 10 finished runs, once for each live run and once for the next, exceeds its limit minus the reserve. A window's limit is its setting when set, else its learned limit, and a window with neither never holds. Live runs, runs the owner starts directly and milestone requests' plan runs (milestone-request-past-usage-hold) are untouched, and the hold clears at the first poll after the window resets
